T3.proof: If gamma has a max x*, P_set gives q with x* <= q, so every gamma(t) <= x* <= q. If gamma has no max (e.g. the infinite chain) and I+ is finite, {i : x_i <= q} is a prefix for each q (past-closed + transitivity), and finitely many prefixes cover N, so one of them is cofinite, i.e. all of N.
T3.statement: If gamma has a maximum element or I+ is finite, then P_set => exists q in I+ with P_whole(q) (hence with P_tail(q)).

Because F1's I+ is R x S^2 (infinite) and gamma: [0,T) has no causal maximum in a globally hyperbolic development, the escape hypotheses are met structurally by the class, so the direction is load-bearing.

The prefix machine check therefore certifies q_j only for j < N, with the in-prefix witness i = max(j+1, t0) <= N; the infinite model's no-top-member step is the symbolic j -> x_{j+1} argument recorded in omega_chain.
